# authentik_object_attribute (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "authentik_object_attribute" "example" {
  object_type = "authentik_core.user"
  key         = "employee_id"
  label       = "Employee ID"
  type        = "text"
  is_unique   = true
  is_required = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String)
- `label` (String)
- `object_type` (String) Content-type of the objects this attribute definition applies to, e.g. `authentik_core.user`.
- `type` (String) Allowed values:
  - `text`
  - `number`
  - `boolean`

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Defaults to `true`.
- `group` (String)
- `is_required` (Boolean)
- `is_unique` (Boolean)
- `managed` (String) Objects that are managed by authentik are created/updated automatically and may be overwritten by later migrations.
- `regex` (String)

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Generated.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_updated` (String) Generated.
